title: scrumia-rhf — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-rhf: the ScrumIA implementation slot for React Hook Form — declarative forms, resolver-driven validation, registered inputs.
tagline: Declarative forms, owned by the library end to end.
responsibilities: Owns the how for React Hook Form in a React app: a form declares a resolver (validation is one schema, not per-field logic), its inputs are registered through the library, and its state is read through watch, getValues, formState or handleSubmit. Three refusals, one audit skill, cited against react-hook-form.com pinned to v7.
refusals: No form without a resolver, no useState + onChange pair where register() already covers it, no state read through the DOM. A SolidJS app pays no cost — the contributions are scoped to scrumia-impl-reactjs only.
philosophy: Assumes the form library is the source of truth for value, validation, touched and dirty state, and submission. Costs the unlearning of a hand-rolled form state, which a project pays once on adopting and stops paying on the next form it ships.
